tools.name: get_current_weather
tools.description: Get current weather conditions for a location in the United States. Perfect for 'What's the weather like in [US location]?' questions. Covers all US states, territories, and coastal waters.

params.name: location
params.description: US location as coordinates (lat,lng) in decimal degrees. Example: '40.7128,-74.0060' for New York City. Must be within US boundaries including states, territories (PR, VI, AS, GU, MP), and coastal wat

tools.name: get_weather_forecast
tools.description: Get multi-day weather forecast for a location in the United States. Perfect for 'What's the forecast for [US location]?' questions. Provides detailed day/night forecasts for up to 7 days.

params.name: days
params.description: Number of days to forecast (1-7, default 7). Each day includes both day and night periods.

params.name: location
params.description: US location as coordinates (lat,lng) in decimal degrees. Example: '40.7128,-74.0060' for New York City. Must be within US boundaries including states, territories (PR, VI, AS, GU, MP), and coastal wat

tools.name: get_hourly_forecast
tools.description: Get hour-by-hour weather forecast for a location in the United States. Perfect for 'What's the hourly forecast?' or 'Will it rain this afternoon in [US location]?' questions. Provides detailed hourly conditions for up to 48 hours.

params.name: hours
params.description: Number of hours to forecast (1-48, default 24). Provides temperature, conditions, and precipitation probability for each hour.

params.name: location
params.description: US location as coordinates (lat,lng) in decimal degrees. Example: '40.7128,-74.0060' for New York City. Must be within US boundaries including states, territories (PR, VI, AS, GU, MP), and coastal wat

tools.name: get_weather_alerts
tools.description: Get active weather alerts, warnings, watches, and advisories for locations in the United States. Perfect for 'Are there any weather alerts in [US location]?' questions. Covers severe weather, winter storms, heat warnings, flood alerts, and more.

params.name: location
params.description: US location as coordinates (lat,lng) in decimal degrees OR 2-letter state/territory code. Examples: '40.7128,-74.0060' for New York City, 'CA' for California, 'PR' for Puerto Rico. Valid state codes:

params.name: severity
params.description: Filter by alert severity: 'extreme' (life-threatening), 'severe' (significant threat), 'moderate' (possible threat), 'minor' (minimal threat), or 'all' (default - shows all active alerts).

tools.name: find_weather_stations
tools.description: Find weather observation stations near a location in the United States. Useful for getting station-specific data, finding data sources, or understanding which stations provide weather data for an area. Includes ASOS, AWOS, and other automated weather stations.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of stations to return (1-20, default 10). Stations are returned ordered by distance from the specified location.

params.name: location
params.description: US location as coordinates (lat,lng) in decimal degrees. Example: '40.7128,-74.0060' for New York City. Must be within US boundaries including states, territories (PR, VI, AS, GU, MP), and coastal wat

tools.name: get_local_time
tools.description: Get the current local time for a US location. Shows what time it is right now at the specified location.

params.name: location
params.description: US location as coordinates (lat,lng) in decimal degrees. Example: '40.7128,-74.0060' for New York City.
